brief:
Four foreign ministers from Britain, Australia, Canada, and Italy warned Sunday that the humanitarian situation in Gaza faces catastrophic conditions as winter sets in, Shehab Wire reported. The officials described the current crisis in dire terms amid ongoing concerns over aid access and civilian welfare in the territory.

The joint warning from the four countries signals growing international alarm over deteriorating conditions in Gaza ahead of the colder months, when shortages of shelter, heating fuel, and medical supplies typically worsen.

title: Four nations warn of humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza as winter approaches
